clips.text: Redefine the conflict, and the apology quietly disappears.
Name what happened in plain words. Don't let a nicer label erase it.
Make him big enough, and the act looks like nothing.
Name the act, not the person. 'He can take it' is not an excuse.
Point the blame at the crowd, and nobody asks about you.
Hold the question on the person. The question was about you — not the crowd.
Call the word the problem, and the behaviour never gets answered.
Name the behaviour, not the label. Don't let the word do the answering.
Deny the miss, blame someone else, and the question goes away.
Name the miss, not the agenda.
Call it small, and nobody asks how big it was.
Name the size of it out loud. Don't let 'small' end the conversation.
